stages.label: 1. Total Historical Spend
stages.calculationBasis: Sum of all historical customer purchase transactions in category.

stages.label: 2. Addressable Spend
stages.calculationBasis: Strictly comparable transactions meeting specification and UOM standards.

stages.label: 3. Contractually / Operationally Addressable Spend
stages.calculationBasis: Spend unlocked and currently available for commercial renegotiation.

stages.label: 4. Price Dispersion Opportunity
stages.calculationBasis: Variance between current weighted purchase price and demonstrated reference price.

stages.label: 5. Volume Aggregation Opportunity
stages.calculationBasis: Historical lower pricing demonstrated across aggregated order volume tiers.

stages.label: 6. E-Auction Opportunity
stages.calculationBasis: Dynamic competitive reverse auction price compression across verified suppliers.

stages.label: 7. Vendor Consolidation Opportunity
stages.calculationBasis: Fragmented tail volume shifted to competitive core suppliers at demonstrated rates.

stages.label: 8. Category Specialist Realignment
stages.calculationBasis: Reallocating demand from multi-category vendors to demonstrated lower-price specialists.

stages.label: 9. Overlap Elimination (Deduplication)
stages.calculationBasis: Shared addressable volume variance eliminated to strictly prevent double-counting.

stages.label: 10. Net Defensible Sourcing Opportunity
stages.calculationBasis: Net mathematically defensible opportunity = Gross Sourcing Levers - Overlap.
